_comment: Copy to node.local.json (gitignored) and fill in your own paths. Placeholders {hub_root}/{pid}/{cache_root}/{sid}/{YYYY-MM} resolve at runtime. The watcher (src/audio_inbox_watch.py) reads this file.
_transcribe_cli: optional: path to media_transcribe_cli.py; defaults to the one next to the watcher
_sources_note: discover=project-inboxes scans {hub_root}/_inbox AND {hub_root}/<pid>/_<pid>_inbox/ AND {hub_root}/<pid>/ top-level files; pid = the <pid> folder name. For a single flat inbox instead use: {"root":"{hub_root}/_inbox","route":"mapper","claim":true}.

outputs._voiceprints_note: project_projection = where the per-project speaker registry (index.json + profiles/ name cards WITHOUT vectors + members.json) lives; set to {hub_root}/{pid} to keep it at the project root. local_cache = node-local dir for the embeddings store (voiceprints.json), kept OFF the shared hub. global_registry = SHARED canonical embeddings store on the hub ({hub_root}/_voiceprints/profiles/{voice_hash}.json + registry.json), so an enroll on one node is readable by others; open (not encrypted) and kept out of git via .gitignore. Omit global_registry to keep embeddings node-local only. All active only when voiceprint_mode != off (see below).
outputs._candidates_out_note: voiceprint_identity.py list-candidates кладёт JSON анонимных профилей-кандидатов (для навыка voiceprint-identity-matching) сюда: project = {hub_root}/{pid}/_voiceprint-candidates-{host}.json (рядом с реестром проекта, видно в Obsidian; по умолчанию); meta = {hub_root}/_meta/801-voiceprint-candidates-{host}.json (рядом с диагностикой узла); root = {hub_root}/_voiceprint-candidates-{host}.json; либо явный путь-шаблон с {hub_root}/{pid}/{host}. {host} в имени, чтобы узлы не затирали друг друга.

_hub_wait_note: гонка старта: задача планировщика стартует по AtLogOn, а облачный диск монтируется через секунды-минуты ПОСЛЕ логина — прогон в этом окне не видел ни Hub, ни секрет на нём и уходил в 'nothing to do'. hub_wait_seconds = сколько ждать появления hub_root перед прогоном (0 = не ждать вовсе, для узлов без облачного Hub); hub_wait_poll_sec = период проб. Здоровый узел не платит ничем: первая проба проходит сразу.
_path_links_note: необязательно: junction/симлинки, чтобы стабильный путь (напр. hub_root) резолвился, когда Google Drive монтируется по другой букве/пути под юзером задачи. update-node.ps1 (шаг 2b) создаёт недостающие. kind: Junction (по умолч., без admin, ТОЛЬКО локальный NTFS-target) | SymbolicLink (гибче, но нужен admin/Developer Mode). ВАЖНО: если диск под этим юзером вообще НЕ смонтирован (виртуальный per-user GDrive), линк не поможет — задачу надо гонять под юзером с примонтированным диском (см. §6 deployment).
_voiceprint_mode_note: off = diarization only (SPEAKER_00/01…); enroll = enroll ONLY the dominant speaker per file (bootstrap, no matching); match = identify speakers against the existing registry, no new enrolls; match_enroll = RECOMMENDED — match every speaker against the registry, enroll the unmatched ones as new profiles (recognize known, remember new; one profile per person). Requires speaker_mode: diarize + HF token.
_ktalk_note: A Ktalk (Kontur.Talk) download is a media file + a transcript naming the speakers. When one is found next to the media, speakers are taken from it and diarization is skipped (ASR still runs). {stem} = media file name without extension; [] disables the lookup. See docs/speaker-recognition.md.
_video_frames_note: OPT-IN slide capture from video: screenshots at key moments + local OCR (RapidOCR, CPU — no GPU contention with ASR), interleaved into the transcript by timecode. mode: 'off' (default) | 'slide-change' (ffmpeg scene detection) | 'interval' (every interval_sec). NOTE on real meeting recordings: scene detection misses slide changes when the recording is a 'speaker + shared screen' layout — the slide occupies part of a static frame. Interval capture plus the filter below is the reliable path there.

video_frames._source_note: Which video of a meeting bundle the frames come from. The ASR primary is the light speaker-only track (fast to decode) — frames taken from it are worthless. Patterns are regexes over the file name, tried in order; the first match wins. fallback: 'largest' picks the biggest remaining video, anything else means 'keep using the ASR input'. Omit the whole block to keep the previous behaviour.
video_frames._filter_note: Which captured frames reach the transcript. Interval capture buys coverage at the cost of noise: a talking head carries no slide text, and one slide held for an hour yields sixty near-identical frames. Filtered frames stay on disk and in slides.json with a reason — nothing is discarded silently. All three knobs are 0 (off) by default; the engine ships the mechanism, the consumer sets the policy. min_ocr_chars: drop frames whose OCR text is shorter. dedupe_similarity: 0..1 over OCR character n-grams vs the previous kept frame. dedupe_visual: 0..1 over a 64-bit difference hash of the picture — this is the one that works, because OCR reads the same slide differently on every pass while the picture does not. Measured on a 2:32 recording: text-only dedupe kept 101 frames of 152, adding dedupe_visual 0.95 brought it to 27. Cost: ~30 s per recording for the hashes.
video_frames._filter_suggested: Working values for meeting recordings with a shared screen: min_ocr_chars 90, dedupe_similarity 0.85, dedupe_visual 0.95.

_cleanup_note: keep the hub tidy. copy_asr_chunk_artifacts:true is the standard mode — it persists per-chunk WAV/JSON so an interrupted long run can resume the finished chunks instead of re-ASR from scratch. It is free on disk because cleanup_intermediates:true prunes those chunks (+ raw/merged dumps + the asr/ scratch dir) after a SUCCESSFUL run; the chunks survive only when a run failed, which is exactly when recovery/resume needs them. Set copy_asr_chunk_artifacts:false only to disable crash-recovery entirely.
_source_disposition_note: OPT-IN inbox cleanup for the SOURCE recordings (transcripts/outputs are never touched). on_asr_done: 'leave' (default) keeps the source + sidecars in place, as today. 'move' relocates the source audio and ALL its sidecars (.state.json, .processed-asr, .claim.json, .asr-log.txt) into a scanner-skipped {source_root}/{processed_dir_name}/ AFTER success — a mirror of _failed/. Nothing is deleted; the session still shows in _sessions-index.md. on_asr_done_after_days is a safety delay: move only once the file is that many days past finished_at (fractional = hours, e.g. 0.25 = 6h; 0 = same sweep).
_scan_knobs: which files the watcher picks up; omit any key to use built-in defaults
_cloud_watchdog: abort a wedged CloudStorage syscall — macOS Google Drive (File Provider) can hang a recursive listdir/stat/open on a dataless subtree indefinitely at 0% CPU, with no Errno of its own. scan_op_timeout_seconds bounds each per-source discovery scan (wedged source is logged + skipped); cloud_op_timeout_seconds bounds the per-file pickup. Make a source available-offline to include one that keeps timing out. No-op on Windows (no SIGALRM).
_scheduling_knobs: CPU-aware deferral + retry policy + optional time window
_cloud_defer_policy: a cloud-mount / staging failure is not the file's fault, so it is re-queued WITHOUT burning an attempt. That path needs its own ceiling: unbounded deferring let one wedged source rack up 14776 no-op runs in 24h on M4-MAC. cloud_defers is counted per file, each defer pushes retry_not_before out by the backoff ladder (minutes, last step repeats), and once max_cloud_defers is reached the file falls through to the ordinary max_attempts / _failed path. Set max_cloud_defers to 0 to disable deferring entirely.
_multi_node: opt-in cross-machine coordination via per-file claim.json
_jobs_queue_note: Declarative extra jobs live in {hub_root}/_jobs. Run .log files are rotated; JSON summaries remain permanently.
_secrets_note: ОТКУДА брать секрет, а не сам секрет. env:ИМЯ = переменная окружения этой машины (ставь её на уровне Machine, иначе scheduled task её не увидит). file:путь = читать из файла; {hub_root}/{config_dir} резолвятся, так что file:{hub_root}/_meta/.hf-token = ОДИН источник на все узлы — новый узел не надо снабжать токеном отдельно. ВНИМАНИЕ: файл на общем диске виден всем, у кого есть доступ к Hub — держи там токен только с правами Read и не расшаривай _meta наружу. Вотчер кладёт значение в окружение подпроцесса движка; сам секрет никогда не логируется.
